checks.name: small_sample_integrity
checks.scope: sample JSON and text presence; not an application loader test

resolved_issues.symptom: The first windowed package timed out; the console diagnostic reported QtCore DLL import failure.
resolved_issues.cause: PyInstaller collected Poppler ICU 78 from the inherited PATH; Qt expected the Windows ICU API.
resolved_issues.fix: Build with a process-local Python and Windows PATH and a fresh project-local analysis directory.

resolved_issues.symptom: After dependency repair, the window was created but the diagnostic process did not exit successfully.
resolved_issues.cause: The frozen executable inherited a cp1252 output encoding and failed while printing a Chinese JSON value.
resolved_issues.fix: Keep the result file UTF-8 and emit ASCII-escaped JSON to the console.

limits: Offscreen source and packaged window creation only; normal desktop interaction is not verified.
Map loading, annotation, persistence and query are not implemented in v0.1.0.
No claim of non-Windows packaging validation.
